# `ilike`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
str ilike pattern[ ESCAPE escape]
```

Returns true if str matches `pattern` with `escape` case-insensitively, null if any arguments are null, false otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ilike('Spark', '_Park');
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT '\\abc' AS S, S ilike r'\\abc', S ilike '\\\\abc';
```

Result:

```text
\abc	true	true
```

```sql
SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=true;
```

Result:

```text
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals	true
```

```sql
SELECT '%SystemDrive%\Users\John' ilike '\%SystemDrive\%\\users%';
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SET spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals=false;
```

Result:

```text
spark.sql.parser.escapedStringLiterals	false
```

```sql
SELECT '%SystemDrive%\\USERS\\John' ilike r'%SystemDrive%\\Users%';
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT '%SystemDrive%/Users/John' ilike '/%SYSTEMDrive/%//Users%' ESCAPE '/';
```

Result:

```text
true
```
